Elena: Windward POC blocker  their Rust on-prem connector can't handle our function-call frames over SSE. Need a short workaround + pricing + security bullets.
Sam: Short fix = run an edge translator in their DMZ to convert function-call frames into POST webhooks their connector already accepts. No Rust change.
Sam: Tiny sketch:
```rust
// pseudo
for chunk in stream {
  if chunk.tool_call { post_webhook(chunk) }
}
```
Priya: Procurement wants hosted vs 12mo Dedicated comparison for ~100 RPS @ ~1.2k tokens/req. Keep it one page with assumptions.
Ben: Ballpark hosted token cost ~ $0.0007-0.0009/token depending on model. For that scale Dedicated (1 GPU reserved) usually wins on TCO. I'll draft numbers with assumptions (model, quant, cache hit-rate).
Elena: Security asks: KMS, SAML SSO, audit logs retention, cert pinning. Can we produce a 1-page checklist?
Ben: Yes. I'll extract SOC2, KMS integration notes, and SSO bits into a checklist and flag items needing legal.
ops-bot: Created ticket WD-4219 for on-prem handoff (assignee: Elena).
Sam: I'll prepare a minimal repo + docker-compose with the translator and a sample webhook payload.
Elena: Plan: Sam = repo + proxy config, Ben = checklist + pricing draft, Priya = one-pager for procurement. I'll consolidate and send to Windward tomorrow AM.
Priya: I can join the infra call.
Elena: Thanks team :thumbsup:
